comment: Red team 11_3 (wall_ends_at_turn, aimed at #9,#1,#7): A right-hand wall ends exactly where the route turns 90 deg left, so the free end is passed while the echelon folds to a column and the leader faces his new heading; the man nearest the end is mid-reshuffle and nobody slices it (check 9), or a right-side man faces the end face too closely (check 1).
